title: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says his P(doom) is "close to zero", arguing that future AI risks stem from closed frontier AI labs, not open-source systems (Will Knight/Wired)
summary: Will Knight / Wired: Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says his P(doom) is “close to zero”, arguing that future AI risks stem from closed frontier AI labs, not open-source systems — “Most of the risk is actually created by a couple of players building behind closed doors,” Clément Delangue said of the need for open source AI.
contentText:
Will Knight / Wired :

Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue says his P(doom) is “close to zero”, arguing that future AI risks stem from closed frontier AI labs, not open-source systems   —  “Most of the risk is actually created by a couple of players building behind closed doors,” Clément Delangue said of the need for open source AI.
